title: MambaLIFT: Reference-Based Mechanism-Aware Attribution for VMamba
abstract: arXiv:2611.25644v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attributing predictions of visual state-space models remains challenging because input-dependent selective dynamics couple feature selection, recurrent state propagation, and shared computational pathways. We introduce MambaLIFT, a reference-based, multiplier-first attribution framework for VMamba that propagates contributions through its computational graph using interaction-aware rules for selective-scan injection, recurrent memory, LayerNorm, and shared pathways. MambaLIFT decomposes the reference-relative class-logit difference, \(f_c(x)-f_c(x^0)\), by spatial position, VSS block, scan direction, and computational mechanism. Experiments on ImageNet-1K evaluate VMamba-T and VMamba-B, with hyperparameters selected on a calibration set and faithfulness assessed on a disjoint held-out evaluation set. MambaLIFT achieves numerical conservation to floating-point precision across audited attribution interfaces in both configurations. Under m

translated_title: MambaLIFT：面向VMamba的基于参考、机制感知的归因方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.25644v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：对视觉状态空间模型的预测进行归因仍然具有挑战性，因为依赖输入的选择性动态机制将特征选择、循环状态传播和共享计算路径耦合在一起。我们提出了MambaLIFT，这是一个面向VMamba的基于参考、乘子优先的归因框架，它使用针对选择性扫描注入、循环记忆、LayerNorm和共享路径的交互感知规则，在其计算图中传播贡献。MambaLIFT按空间位置、VSS块、扫描方向和计算机制，对相对于参考的类别logit差异 f_c(x)-f_c(x^0) 进行分解。在ImageNet-1K上的实验评估了VMamba-T和VMamba-B两种模型，超参数在校准集上选取，忠实性则在不相交的独立评估集上进行评估。MambaLIFT在两种配置下的所有经审计的归因接口上均实现了浮点精度级别的数值守恒。
tldr: 提出了MambaLIFT，一个针对VMamba视觉状态空间模型的基于参考、机制感知的归因框架，能够按空间位置、VSS块、扫描方向和计算机制精确分解模型预测的贡献，并在浮点精度下实现数值守恒。
en_tdlr: MambaLIFT, a reference-based mechanism-aware attribution framework for VMamba, accurately decomposes model predictions by spatial position, VSS block, scan direction, and computational mechanism while achieving numerical conservation at floating-point precision.
